decisions.reason: The supplied October 13 publication date is within the frozen window. Accept as a new evaluation method and a bounded research-team result: claim-level evidence tracking directly serves the series. The authors report only 14 of 90 end-to-end claims met their criteria; this supports scrutiny of agent success reports, not universal model rankings ([saved Appendix G, per-claim verdicts](data/assets/51fd6c05fff2f297f454f717/9f5a3d8ad0d87cf4b75e0b27ee825183acc71c2811e8bb96e1a59f3c5dca2c35/text.txt#:~:text=Of%20the%2090)). Human researchers constructed and reviewed the task and rubrics; the LLM judge received researcher spot-checking, not exhaustive independent validation. Further human review is a safeguard, not evidence that judge bias occurred ([§3.3](data/assets/51fd6c05fff2f297f454f717/9f5a3d8ad0d87cf4b75e0b27ee825183acc71c2811e8bb96e1a59f3c5dca2c35/text.txt#:~:text=A%20domain%20researcher%20spot-checked)). Limits include one anchor task, permitted optimization on test sessions, and no private FALCON evaluation; students should distinguish logged development results from untouched tests ([Appendix B, Data and test access](data/assets/51fd6c05fff2f297f454f717/9f5a3d8ad0d87cf4b75e0b27ee825183acc71c2811e8bb96e1a59f3c5dca2c35/text.txt#:~:text=Train%2C%20validation%2C%20and%20test)). The nominal budget is one 32-GB GPU and 72 hours without a token cap, while orchestration systems received different instruction coverage and ran on different hosts; shared model identity therefore does not isolate orchestration effects completely (§4.3; Appendices A and F). The benchmark authors evaluate their own framework, an intellectual interest; commercial conflicts and independent replication are not established by the supplied text. Use the preprint's methodology and reported failures with these limitations, not as settled superiority or cost evidence.

The supplied September 16 publication date falls on the inclusive window boundary. The new evidence is this report of an older April–May experiment, not a newly conducted run ([saved §4.3](data/assets/59b2cb8b434efeeb70a133bc/66025228eaffdbf60602a9c3e085782385578f7304cce9751aff2a52b9936729/text.txt#:~:text=from%20the%20setup%20commit%20on%20April%2026)). Accept for inspectable experiment lineage, negative-result retention and verification design. The developers report a development-score reduction from 3.3923 to 1.899044 bpb, but every component was selected on the same 200-text evaluator; the last improvement was below cross-hardware variation ([§4.5, Primary result](data/assets/59b2cb8b434efeeb70a133bc/66025228eaffdbf60602a9c3e085782385578f7304cce9751aff2a52b9936729/text.txt#:~:text=Every%20component%20was%20selected)). Different-account verifications within this experiment are not independent external replication. Humans defined the task, changed the platform and prompts, and launched an additional session whose result entered the winning ancestry: describe human-guided research, not fully autonomous discovery ([§4.7](data/assets/59b2cb8b434efeeb70a133bc/66025228eaffdbf60602a9c3e085782385578f7304cce9751aff2a52b9936729/text.txt#:~:text=Humans%20acted%20before%20and%20during%20the%20run)). Missing evaluator logs and dependency/data pins, and the authors' explicit statement that they did not rerun the winner, limit reproducibility ([§4.8](data/assets/59b2cb8b434efeeb70a133bc/66025228eaffdbf60602a9c3e085782385578f7304cce9751aff2a52b9936729/text.txt#:~:text=We%20did%20not%20rerun)). The developer-authored account has an intellectual interest in Agora; no financial disclosure or external researcher validation is supplied. Its conclusion explicitly requires matched comparisons before claiming discovery efficiency. Student implication: adopt provenance and verification records, while requiring held-out evaluation and matched compute budgets before claiming gains.

The supplied September 24 publication date is eligible. Accept this practitioner report for concrete failure cases and experimental safeguards, with performance claims explicitly attributed to its authors. Its contribution is a production failure taxonomy and cost-sensitive workflow design, not a new algorithm ([saved Contributions passage](data/assets/7082835cef4c8540dcb8d480/7d04403761d8cb23614022d48ddb879a6de4fb7f5af821bb1d1d2cb773d97ec4/text.txt#:~:text=the%20contribution%20is%20not%20a%20new%20algorithm)). Human-maintained research instructions and strategic pivots were essential in System B; these are changes to research guidance, not model-weight training or hands-free discovery (§§IV-C–E). The reported 1.82× Recall@6 lift is a peak-date result; the authors give 1.63× for the across-date mean. Neither establishes online customer benefit ([§V-A](data/assets/7082835cef4c8540dcb8d480/7d04403761d8cb23614022d48ddb879a6de4fb7f5af821bb1d1d2cb773d97ec4/text.txt#:~:text=Even%20the%20across-date%20mean)). Examine two substantive tensions: §V-A claims component causality, while the limitations admit accumulated iterations remain a confound; §V-E says an immutable evaluator prevents metric gaming, while §III-E documents unusable clusters produced by optimizing coherence. Evaluator immutability therefore does not establish metric validity ([metric-fixation example](data/assets/7082835cef4c8540dcb8d480/7d04403761d8cb23614022d48ddb879a6de4fb7f5af821bb1d1d2cb773d97ec4/text.txt#:~:text=maximizing%20codebook%20size), [limitations](data/assets/7082835cef4c8540dcb8d480/7d04403761d8cb23614022d48ddb879a6de4fb7f5af821bb1d1d2cb773d97ec4/text.txt#:~:text=The%20component%20ablation)). Proprietary purchase data prevents direct public reproduction; two workstreams within Amazon are not external replication, and the account carries an organizational commercial interest ([Reproducibility](data/assets/7082835cef4c8540dcb8d480/7d04403761d8cb23614022d48ddb879a6de4fb7f5af821bb1d1d2cb773d97ec4/text.txt#:~:text=is%20proprietary%20and%20cannot%20be%20released)). For students, retain small loops, durable failure logs, budget-aware gates and human metric review as practical suggestions; do not present estimated labor savings or the two-system cost comparison as independently established efficiency.

The supplied October 11 publication date is eligible, but this roundup offers discovery links rather than inspectable evidence of autonomous experiment execution or verification. Its ATLAS and Epoch entries merit separate original-source review; their full reports, methods, budgets and results are not supplied here ([saved AI resources entries](data/assets/78deb02bb43b9240c74487b3/4c16684f04ac89de0cfd2e9942cde9c20a91e0d7aa7d934da6ede6eaa2463817/text.txt#:~:text=AI%20resources)). The roundup supplies no independent validation and must not be counted separately from those underlying reports. General releases and productivity tools do not establish research outcomes. The publisher also promotes paid content, a visible subscription interest, although no specific vendor sponsorship is established ([paid-content promotion](data/assets/78deb02bb43b9240c74487b3/4c16684f04ac89de0cfd2e9942cde9c20a91e0d7aa7d934da6ede6eaa2463817/text.txt#:~:text=All%20my%20paid%20goodies)). Reject this item as series evidence; its discovery value does not warrant inclusion.
